title: Head of Analytics & Insight
description: We are seeking an experienced Head of Analytics & Insight to join our senior leadership team, reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer. You will lead a team of 12 analysts and data scientists, driving evidence-based decision making across the integrated care system. This is a strategic leadership role — your primary output is insight that shapes Board-level strategy, commissioning decisions, and population health planning. You will work closely with the CFO and COO to develop a data strategy for the ICB, and represent analytics at executive level. The successful candidate will have a track record of translating complex data into clear strategic recommendations. Experience in NHS or health/care settings strongly preferred. Hybrid working from Sheffield office 2 days per week.

title: Senior Data Manager
description: Bupa is looking for a Senior Data Manager to lead our MI and reporting function within the Finance directorate. You will manage a team of 4 analysts producing monthly management information packs and board reports. The role involves some stakeholder engagement across the business. Strong SQL and Excel skills required. You will be responsible for maintaining data quality and ensuring reports are delivered on time. Some involvement in a data transformation project over the next 12 months. Office based in London 3 days per week. Experience in insurance or financial services preferred.

title: Data Engineer
description: We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our fast-growing data platform team. You will design and build scalable ETL pipelines processing millions of transactions daily using Spark, Kafka, and Airflow. Deep expertise in Python and SQL is essential. You will work within an engineering squad responsible for data infrastructure, collaborating closely with ML engineers and backend developers. This is a hands-on technical role — you will be writing production code every day. Experience with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) required. No prior fintech experience necessary. On-site in our London office.
